# Idle — Web Playables

> A browser-game lab built to learn idle mechanics and portable HTML5 distribution. The retained result is Idle Startup: playable here, packaged for the web and YouTube Playables.


<!-- Keep in sync with robots.txt and ai.txt. -->

## Public pages

- [idle.](https://idle.aliveville.com/index.md): A browser-game lab built to learn idle mechanics and portable HTML5 distribution. The retained result is Idle Startup: playable here, packaged for the web and YouTube Playables.
- [Idle Startup](https://idle.aliveville.com/play/idle-startup.md): Ship features. Hire the team. Raise the round.
